blocks.text: PETALING JAYA, Malaysia – Some 40 areas in Malaysia continue recording unhealthy Air Pollutant Index (API) readings as at 6pm on Sept 15. Johan Setia in Selangor recorded the highest API reading with 189, according to the Environment Department’s Air Pollutant Index Management System (APIMS).
